title: The Biomechanical Investigation of Osseointegration Levels in Titanium Implants Simultaniously Placed with Different Bone Grafts
authors: Guler R, Dundar S, Bozoglan A, Ozcan EC, Ozupek MF, Acikan I, Gunes N, Bingul MB. Niger J Clin Pract. 2024 Mar 1;27(3):310-316.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “As a result of this study, it can be thought that different graft materials can be successfully used in peri -implant-guided bone regeneration and may be an alternative to autogenous grafts” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
